steps.en: Reports are routed to the officer's dashboard
steps.why_en: The dashboard is empty; reports are only emailed to fixed lists.
steps.why_id: Dashboard kosong; laporan hanya dikirim email ke daftar tetap.

steps.en: The officer clicks a report on the dashboard
steps.why_en: No report item exists on the dashboard to click.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada item laporan di dashboard untuk diklik.

steps.en: The report is shown on screen
steps.why_en: Some reports show rows; file reports only list file names.
steps.why_id: Sebagian laporan tampil sebagai baris; laporan file hanya daftar nama file.

steps.en: The officer exports the report to Excel
steps.why_en: Excel export exists for several reports only, with an open defect.
steps.why_id: Export Excel hanya ada di beberapa laporan, dan ada defect terbuka.

steps.en: The officer exports the report to PDF
steps.why_en: No PDF export exists; only Excel or ZIP.
steps.why_id: Export PDF tidak ada; hanya Excel atau ZIP.

steps.en: The officer saves a copy of the report
steps.why_en: Download works, but some report tabs lack download permission.
steps.why_id: Download berjalan, tapi beberapa tab laporan tidak punya izin download.
